other_conditions: Applicant must be a Start-up certified by the Start‑up Promotion Cell (SPC) or an incubator/accelerator enlisted with SPC.
The applicant can apply for this scheme only once in their lifetime.
Bank accounts of the Directors of the company must be linked to Aadhaar.

Only expenditures incurred from one year before the notification of Goa Start‑up Policy 2017, within the policy’s validity and paid digitally are eligible for reimbursement; otherwise, SPC may approve on a case‑by‑case basis.
A start‑up can avail the benefits of this scheme only once.
Application must be submitted within six months of incurring the relevant expenditure.
Up to 100 start‑ups can avail the benefits of this scheme per year.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of stamp duty exceeding ₹100 for land or developed‑area lease/sale transactions undertaken by eligible start‑ups, incubators or accelerators.
